Foodify · clickable prototype · rendered from the theme
A working prototype of the new letsfoodify.com, generated from the real WordPress theme. Browse, filter, open any product, add to the cart, check out, and find the order in your account. In the cart, try the partner code NALIN10.
What is real and what is not

Real: the layout, type, colours and every component come from the theme the developer installs. The cart follows the shop's actual rules — free delivery from ₹599 after codes, ₹59 below it, ₹25 off for paying online, cash on delivery on every order.

Stood in for: Razorpay's payment window (a simulated payment), the SMS that carries the sign-in code (any six digits work), and food photography (coloured bowls, pending the shoot). Nothing here is sent anywhere; the prototype remembers your cart and orders in this browser only, and Reset clears them.

Invented for the prototype, awaiting your word: the FSSAI licence number (10012345000001), the same-day NCR dispatch promise, the "Complete the meal" pairing, the combo boxes with their contents and prices, each product's price, ingredients, allergens, nutrition, taste notes, cooked weight, FAQ and reviews, and the partner code. The shop holds 44 products, as the live site does, but only the observed SKUs are real names (Dal Fry, Dal Makhni, Idli Sambhar, Pav Bhaji, Palak Gravy, Dal Khichdi, Aloo ka Mazaa, Super Millet Idli, the millet-beetroot cheela, Masala Chai, Lemon Masala Tea, Coconut Red Chutney, Schezwan Rice); the rest stand in until Foodify sends its list. Allergens are worked out from each ingredient list against FSSAI's declarable allergens, so they are only as right as the ingredients. The live site prints NOT CONFIGURED for a licence it has not been given — nothing here is live until you confirm it.

Shipping is shown in the cart, not at the last screen. MRP is inclusive of all taxes.

The dal you would make on a Tuesday if you had the hour: yellow moong and toor, tempered with cumin, tomato and a little ghee, then dried slowly so the tempering survives.

Built for the places a stove is not — a train berth, a hostel drawer, a hotel kettle, a desk at nine at night. One pack is dinner for two, or a very good lunch for one.

Taste profileSavouryMildly spicyTangy

Ingredients
Split yellow lentils (moong, toor), tomato, ghee, cumin, turmeric, coriander, asafoetida, salt, red chilli.
Allergens
Milk (ghee), Cereals containing gluten (wheat, in the asafoetida)
Net quantity
80 g
Servings per pack
2
Makes (cooked)
260 g
Veg / non-veg
Vegetarian
Storage
Cool, dry place. Use within 3 days of opening.

Nutrition, per serving

Energy312 kcal
Protein14 g
Carbohydrate44 g
of which sugars3 g
Fat8 g
Sodium620 mg

  1. 1Tip it into a bowlThe whole pack. No pan, no measuring.
  2. 2Add boiling waterTo the line on the pack, and stir once.

    What delivery costs

    • Free on orders of ₹599 or more, counted after any partner or creator code.

    Our story

    Instant, preservative-free, home-style Indian food — dal, idli, khichdi, chai and chutney — that comes back to life with hot water, a few minutes on the stove, or a stir of cold water.

    It is made for the places a kitchen is not: a train berth, a hostel room, a hotel kettle, an office desk, a parent who cooks less than they used to. Every pack keeps for nine to twelve months without preservatives.

    To come from Foodify. The founder's story, in Nalin's words, and photographs of the kitchen and the team.

    Partner with us

    Gyms, cafés, colleges, travel desks and creators: give your people a Foodify code, and every order they place with it is credited to you.

    • Your code takes money off your customer's order at checkout.
    • Every order placed with it is recorded against your name — once, even if a second code is entered.
    • You see what your code has sold.
